init_SawyerHandlePressEnv: create a SawyerHandlePressEnv instance to initialize the handle press task environment with default hand and object bounds
step_SawyerHandlePressEnv: run a single environment step by calling step on SawyerHandlePressEnv with an action to get observation and reward
reset_model_SawyerHandlePressEnv: reset the SawyerHandlePressEnv model to initial state with randomized or fixed object and handle positions
compute_reward_SawyerHandlePressEnv: compute the reward for a handle press action using reach distance and press distance metrics
